summary: Research comparison is complete with actual OpenResearch runs and honest negative/partial outcomes, but the full project acceptance remains unmet. G01-G06 were independently checked against source; this review adds cache immutability and stale-output findings.

findings.requirement: Robust structured generation, grounded validation, and durable diagnostics/progress

evidence.detail: Brief claim validation and citation checks; gist_evidence is not scanned by validate_citations.
Only unknown IDs trigger repair; missing evidence and malformed provider output fail without durable partial outputs.
Run outputs are returned only after briefing and every fixed question finish.
JSON mode is requested but malformed content raises; no bounded response repair or per-phase persistence.
Independent run records actual failures for missing evidence and malformed provider JSON.

findings.fix: Add fail-closed bounded schema/response handling without inventing evidence. Persist effective configuration, source/model/phase/question identity, valid intermediate artifacts, and diagnostics before later phases can fail.
findings.acceptance_test: Regression tests cover malformed/fenced/partial JSON, missing evidence, and failure on a late question; run artifacts preserve phase, question id, settings, source hash, partial valid results, and the exact failure. Do not alter frozen experiment history.

findings.requirement: Full-source grounded follow-up with coherent retrieval and honest unknown answers

evidence.detail: Sparse token ranking returns at most 12 matches with radius 1; no coherent/full-source negative-answer verification.
Only retrieved excerpts are sent to the model; empty retrieval directly abstains.
Fixed questions miss numeric, contextual, API, and late recommendation evidence present in the full source.

findings.fix: Use source-aware coherent windows and improved recall for numbers, aliases, translated queries, limitations, and late-source evidence. Distinguish retrieval miss from full-source absence.
findings.acceptance_test: Frozen eight-question regression checks required evidence recall and grounded answers for 5.1B, context caveats, conditional final recommendation, API/NAS distinctions; unknown claims must not be inferred from incomplete windows.

findings.requirement: Original-language track selection/provenance and explicit output-language policy

evidence.detail: Unknown source language becomes und and warns, but the bundle remains usable; requested language does not enforce selected track.
Extraction language is requested but actual language mismatch is not gated before analysis.
Actual B run had und/English-dominant transcript and content distortions; it is not an original-RU comparator.

findings.fix: Separate source language from summary language, preserve actual track provenance/raw extractor output, and fail as non-comparable or explicitly label fallback when language/track cannot be verified.
findings.acceptance_test: Fixtures reject or explicitly mark und/mismatched-language extraction before benchmark analysis; verify Russian output independently and ensure no ASR/auth/cookie fallback is introduced.

findings.requirement: Citation validity, factual support, attribution, and author-statement/inference separation

evidence.detail: Citation scanner handles evidence/segment_ids but not gist_evidence; briefing validator checks presence but not semantic support.
Missing gist citations are copied from topic evidence; caveats are uncited and render_brief drops useful_ideas.kind.
Factual answer prose can remain while empty claims cause abstained=true.
Actual baseline had valid-looking IDs but unsupported attribution/caveat and cited-context mismatch; ID existence alone is insufficient.

findings.fix: Validate every citation field, remove unrelated gist-citation derivation, preserve source/inference labels, cite caveats, and reject or safely replace unsupported answer prose and unsupported speaker identity.
findings.acceptance_test: Tests cover unknown gist IDs, empty claims with factual prose, caveat evidence, conservative unnamed-speaker policy, source/inference rendering, and citation-to-claim context review.

findings.requirement: Honest cold/warm and per-call model/usage/prompt/retrieval measurements

evidence.detail: extract_cold is only wrapper miss time; warm reuse is a boolean, not measured warm Q&A or extraction.
Only current last_response metadata is returned; QA calls/chunks/synthesis usage and dynamic prompt identity are omitted.
Provider response metadata is overwritten on each call.
Research audit documents uncertain upstream cache, incomplete usage, missing setup/partial-progress measurements, and runtime QA prompt drift.

findings.fix: Rename or directly measure cache states; record every inference call's requested/returned model, usage and prompt/retrieval/version identity, effective configuration, and explicit missing metrics.
findings.acceptance_test: Multi-call regression verifies aggregate or explicitly incomplete usage and prompt/config metadata. Bounded live cached-Q&A smoke confirms exact source hash and instrumented zero extractor/non-LLM network calls; cost remains not measured unless actually captured.

findings.requirement: Documented CLI input/JSON surface, reproducible setup, and actionable diagnostics

evidence.detail: Design promises local timed-transcript input and JSON output for all public commands.
CLI only exposes YouTube URL commands; no common --json/local transcript mode; doctor uses a fixed external Baoyu path and checks existence only.
Sets up Bun and summarize locally; Baoyu remains an external dependency.

findings.fix: Align docs with supported behavior or implement local timed transcript and stable JSON output. Make doctor/setup verify concrete versions and clearly diagnose missing external Baoyu source/runtime.
findings.acceptance_test: CLI help covers every documented command and JSON shape; a synthetic local timed-transcript fixture runs without network; doctor tests missing and mismatched tool versions and provides actionable errors.

evidence.detail: save atomically overwrites the same platform/video/language/variant cache paths without checking prior source hash.
Test asserts that a second save with the same key replaces first source content.
Design requires immutable raw evidence and stable identity.

findings.fix: Make source snapshots write-once or content-versioned; changed raw hash for an existing identity must cause an explicit conflict/new snapshot, never silent replacement.
findings.acceptance_test: Save changed content under same logical identity and verify original snapshot/hash remains readable, conflict/new version is explicit, and both entries have independently verified metadata and source hashes.

evidence.detail: Output directory is reused and newest transcript-raw.json is selected after process success without proving it was produced by this invocation.

findings.fix: Use a unique invocation output directory or compare pre/post outputs and require a newly verified raw file plus matching target metadata.
findings.acceptance_test: Pre-existing stale raw JSON with a successful subprocess that writes no new file must fail; newly emitted matching-target output must pass.

verification.reason: Frozen experiment branches are preserved; C answerless-attempt cap was reached. Actual run IDs/results and limitations were audited from reports/comparison.md, reports/comparison.json, reports/spec-review.md, and docs/research/openresearch-manifest.json.
verification.remote: Pre-existing origin observed; not modified and no push/fetch performed.

non_blocking_notes: Valid segment IDs/timestamps do not prove that a citation supports its claim.
Comparison is a single-video case study with common-mode captions bias and no independent audio/visual truth check.
Reusable canonical/default skill deployment and final project audit remain downstream work, not approved by this review.
